english: Well then, I disagree with your third reason up above: it is not the case that there are many examples of things which are not working things, but which are still different from changing things. If you do disagree, then let's consider working things. It is too the case that there are many examples of things which are not working things, but which are still different from changing things; Because definitions are one example, and things being defined are another.
